entries.en: Exercise, sleep, hydration, and care reminders will be added later.

entries.zh: 症状、慢病、用药、手术、过敏、家族史
entries.en: Symptoms, chronic conditions, medications, surgery, allergies, family history

entries.zh: 药物过敏 (体检及就医高危项)
entries.en: Drug allergies (high-risk for exams and care)

entries.zh: 未找到匹配过敏原，可在下方自定义录入
entries.en: No matching allergen found; enter a custom one below

entries.zh: 添加其他未列出的过敏原
搜索过敏原名称 (如：头孢、花粉、大豆)
entries.en: Search allergen name (e.g. cephalosporin, pollen, soy)

entries.zh: 贴心提示：如果没有相关过敏反应，请直接点击下方保存即可。
entries.en: Tip: If you have no relevant allergies, tap Save below.

entries.zh: 环境与吸入性过敏 (季节性)
补充备注 (例如：确诊时间、首次发作表现、抢救史等)...
entries.en: Additional notes (e.g. diagnosis date, first episode, emergency history)…

entries.zh: 您过往是否有明确的过敏经历？
entries.en: Do you have any confirmed allergy history?

entries.zh: 了解您的过敏史，是保障用药安全、规避过敏原以及提供智能就医指导中最核心的防线。
entries.en: Allergy history is essential for medication safety, allergen avoidance, and smart care guidance.

entries.zh: 您的核心健康基线已盘点完毕。系统已将您的日常症状、既往史、用药、手术、过敏及家族史进行多维整合，正用于为您量身定制 AI 深度体检方案。
entries.en: Your core health baseline is complete. Symptoms, history, medications, surgery, allergies, and family history are integrated for your AI exam plan.

entries.zh: 了解您直系亲属的过往病史，有助于我们为您识别潜在的遗传风险，并在体检中为您针对性地推荐慢病与癌症筛查项目。
entries.en: Family history helps identify inherited risks and target chronic disease and cancer screening in your exam plan.

entries.zh: 既往疾病 / 长期用药
完善基础档案有助于为你量身定制体检项目推荐，并提供精准的慢病与癌症风险筛查。
entries.en: Completing your basic profile helps tailor exam recommendations and chronic disease and cancer risk screening.

entries.zh:
为什么要问？
年龄会影响体检频率、慢病风险和部分癌症筛查建议。
entries.en:
Why we ask:
Age affects exam frequency, chronic disease risk, and some cancer screening recommendations.

entries.zh: 分步维护慢病、用药、生活习惯、体检和症状随访
entries.en: Step through chronic conditions, medications, lifestyle, exams, and symptom follow-up

entries.zh: 了解你过往的确诊疾病与慢病史，有助于我们为你避开潜在医疗风险，并定制更精准的体检项目与复查周期。
entries.en: Knowing your diagnosed conditions and chronic history helps us avoid risks and tailor exams and follow-up.

entries.zh: 搜索疾病名称 (支持拼音/首字母)
是否曾被确诊过任何慢性疾病或重大疾病？
entries.en: Have you ever been diagnosed with a chronic or major disease?

entries.zh: 拍照 / 上传门诊病历或出院小结
entries.en: Photo / upload outpatient record or discharge summary

entries.zh: 未找到匹配疾病，可在下方自定义录入
entries.en: No matching condition found; enter a custom one below

entries.zh: 补充备注 (例如：并发症、主治医院等)...
添加其他未列出的疾病
贴心提示：如果没有相关病史，请直接点击下方保存即可。
entries.en: Tip: If you have no relevant history, tap Save below.

entries.zh: 系统将自动解析医学术语，提取确诊疾病与关键指标
entries.en: Medical terms will be parsed automatically to extract diagnoses and key indicators

entries.zh: 系统将启动 AI 智能 OCR 识别，自动提取您的异常指标与结论。
entries.en: AI OCR will extract abnormal indicators and conclusions automatically.

entries.zh: 点击报告卡片进入 AI 异常项确认与体检计划生成。
entries.en: Tap a report card to confirm AI-detected abnormalities and generate an exam plan.

entries.zh: 拍照 / 扫描纸质报告
报告摘要 / 核心异常项 (选填)
电子体检报告导入 (推荐)
可简要记录您记忆中的异常（如：甲状腺结节、高血脂），或留空等待 AI 扫描解析
entries.en: Briefly note remembered abnormalities (e.g. thyroid nodules, high lipids), or leave blank for AI scan parsing
Do you have historical exam reports?

entries.zh: 您的直系亲属（父母、祖父母、外祖父母、兄弟姐妹）是否有人患有明确的慢性疾病或肿瘤病史？
entries.en: Do any close relatives (parents, grandparents, siblings) have confirmed chronic diseases or cancer?

entries.zh: 搜索疾病或肿瘤名称 (如: 肠癌、高血压)
entries.en: Search disease or cancer name (e.g. colon cancer, hypertension)

entries.zh: 建议关注肠镜或粪便潜血筛查时机。
entries.en: Consider timing for colonoscopy or fecal occult blood screening.

entries.zh: 亲属确诊时的大致年龄 (选填)
entries.en: Approximate age at diagnosis for relative (optional)

entries.zh: 贴心提示：如果直系亲属身体都健康或不了解，请直接点击下方保存。
entries.en: Tip: If close relatives are healthy or unknown, tap Save below.

entries.zh: 建议关注肝脏彩超、AFP 及乙肝相关风险。
entries.en: Consider liver ultrasound, AFP, and hepatitis-related risk screening.

entries.zh: 补充备注 (例如：多位亲属患同类病、发病细节等)...
entries.en: Additional notes (e.g. multiple relatives with same disease, onset details)…

entries.zh: 阿尔茨海默病/老年痴呆
建议结合年龄提前开展年度乳腺超声或钼靶筛查。
entries.en: Consider annual breast ultrasound or mammography based on age.

entries.zh: 建议在体检计划中纳入对应风险筛查。
entries.en: Include corresponding risk screening in your exam plan.

entries.zh: 建议定期监测血压、血脂和心脑血管风险。
entries.en: Monitor blood pressure, lipids, and cardiovascular risk regularly.

entries.zh: 建议定期监测空腹血糖与糖化血红蛋白。
entries.en: Monitor fasting glucose and HbA1c regularly.

entries.zh: 建议结合吸烟史评估低剂量胸部 CT 筛查。
entries.en: Consider low-dose chest CT screening based on smoking history.

entries.zh: 程序员 / 开发 / 产品 / 设计
了解您的日常作息与生活方式，有助于更精准地评估心血管与代谢机能，并为您生成每天都能轻松执行的健康改善建议。
entries.en: Understanding your daily routine and lifestyle helps assess cardiovascular and metabolic health and provide actionable daily improvements.

entries.zh: 轻松点：如果平时身体健康，各项都可以直接选择“无”；如果记不太清，也可以随时选择“不清楚”。
entries.en: No pressure: if you're generally healthy, choose "None"; if unsure, choose "Not sure".

entries.zh: 其他偏好酒类 (自定义输入)
我们深知医疗隐私的重要性。体检报告与解析结果将被严格隔离保护，仅用于为你生成个人健康计划。
entries.en: We take medical privacy seriously. Exam reports and parsed results are isolated and used only for your personal health plan.

entries.zh: 记录近期的身体不适，以便在后续复查或就医时提供准确参考。
entries.en: Record recent discomfort for accurate reference during follow-up or care.

entries.zh: 体检记录、关键指标、下一次体检计划
entries.en: Exam records, key indicators, next exam plan

entries.zh: 请选择最接近你日常工作状态的职业：
entries.en: Select the occupation closest to your daily work:

entries.zh: 教学授课、站立与沟通较多，作息受课程安排影响
entries.en: Teaching-heavy, lots of standing and communication, schedule driven by classes

entries.zh: 常规办公室工作、久坐明显、节奏相对固定
entries.en: Regular office work, clearly sedentary, relatively fixed pace

entries.zh: 已为您生成的健康行为档案
性别、出生日期、身高体重、职业、久坐时间
entries.en: Sex, date of birth, height/weight, occupation, sedentary time

entries.zh: 久坐、体力劳动或重复作业并存，作息与负荷差异大
entries.en: Mix of sedentary work, physical labor, or repetitive tasks with varied schedules and workload

entries.zh: 销售 / 商务 / 自由职业
我们深知医疗隐私的重要性。此数据将被严格隔离保护，绝不用于任何未经授权的商业用途。
entries.en: We take medical privacy seriously. This data is strictly isolated and never used for unauthorized commercial purposes.

entries.zh: 平均每天在椅子或沙发上坐多久？
entries.en: On average, how long do you sit in a chair or on a sofa each day?

entries.zh: 办公室文职 / 财务 / 法务 / 企业管理
基础档案 -> 病史 -> 生活习惯 -> 体检档案
entries.en: Basic profile → Medical history → Lifestyle → Exam archive

entries.zh: 贴心提示：诚实记录是对自己负责的第一步。即使现在的习惯不够完美也没关系，Look健康会陪你一起逐步改善。
entries.en: Tip: Honest records are the first step. Imperfect habits are okay—Look Health will help you improve gradually.

entries.zh: 司机 / 物流 / 快递 / 制造业工人

entries.en: Will include the following four sections

entries.zh: 时长处于成年人理想区间
entries.en: Within the ideal adult sleep range

entries.zh: 不同的职业特征伴随着不同的作息规律与环境暴露风险，这能让体检项目推荐和健康建议更贴近实际。
entries.en: Different occupations come with different routines and exposure risks, helping us tailor exam recommendations and health advice.

entries.zh:
为什么要问？
性别会影响乳腺、宫颈、前列腺等筛查项目推荐。
entries.en:
Why we ask:
Sex affects screening recommendations such as breast, cervical, and prostate exams.

entries.zh: 确认，去生成定制体检计划
entries.en: Confirm and generate custom exam plan

entries.zh: 请确认你的基础健康档案信息，随时可以点击各项进行修正。
entries.en: Confirm your basic health profile; tap any item to edit.

entries.zh: 手动补充其他职业名称
偏久坐、用脑强度高、常伴随加班与屏幕暴露
entries.en: Mostly sedentary, high mental workload, often overtime and screen exposure

entries.zh: 还没有填写医疗资料。可以从任意一组开始，也可以直接使用「开始全部流程」一次性完成。
entries.en: No medical profile yet. Start with any section, or use "Start full flow" to complete everything at once.

entries.zh: 倒班、站立、夜班与职业暴露风险相对更高
entries.en: Shift work, standing, night shifts, and higher occupational exposure risk

entries.notes: shared across 2 files; contains format placeholders

entries.zh: “Look健康”会严格保护你的隐私，此数据仅用于为你生成个人健康报告。
entries.en: Look Health strictly protects your privacy. This data is used only to generate your personal health report.

entries.zh: 已填写 %@ 项关键指标
已录入的健康医疗档案
睡眠偏长，如持续可咨询医生
entries.en: Sleep is long; consult a doctor if this persists

entries.zh: 您的夜间睡眠通常感觉
entries.en: How your nightly sleep usually feels

entries.zh: 了解日常饮酒频率能够协助我们科学评估您的肝脏代谢负荷与血压波动趋势，以便在体检推荐中为您规避或加强特定项目的筛查。
entries.en: Drinking frequency helps assess liver load and blood pressure trends to adjust recommended screening items.

entries.zh: 其他运动方式 (自定义输入)
高质量的睡眠是神经系统修复、免疫因子生成与血糖稳定的基石。记录您的日常睡眠，有助于我们全面分析您的日常精力与亚健康状态。
entries.en: Quality sleep supports nervous system repair, immunity, and stable blood sugar. Recording sleep helps assess energy and subhealth.

entries.zh: 睡眠偏少，建议关注作息规律
entries.en: Sleep is on the low side; consider improving your routine

entries.zh: 合理的运动评估能帮助我们了解您的基础代谢率、肌肉质量与心肺耐力，从而为您提供更具针对性的体重管理与防病运动处方。
entries.en: Exercise assessment helps us understand metabolism, muscle mass, and cardio fitness for tailored weight and prevention plans.

entries.zh: 长期连续久坐会直接影响心血管与代谢机能，了解此项数据能为你定制针对性的运动唤醒与健康调理方案。
entries.en: Prolonged sitting affects cardiovascular and metabolic health; this helps tailor movement and wellness plans.

entries.zh: 接近成人推荐睡眠下限
entries.en: Near the lower recommended sleep range for adults

entries.zh: 评估吸烟习惯有助于精准预测心血管健康、肺部代谢及肿瘤潜在风险，从而为您定制更科学的专项体检防御方案。
entries.en: Smoking assessment helps predict cardiovascular, lung, and cancer risks for a tailored screening plan.

entries.zh: 了解您的用药史，有助于我们为您提供更精准的复查项目建议、服药提醒，并辅助报告的上下文解读。
entries.en: Knowing your medication history helps us recommend follow-up tests, reminders, and contextual report interpretation.

entries.zh: 目前是否正在长期服用药物，或有近期的处方用药记录？
entries.en: Are you currently on long-term medications or recent prescriptions?

entries.zh: 缺少成员信息，无法加载用药档案。
entries.en: Member information missing; cannot load medication profile.

entries.zh: 暂无用药记录，可通过下方按钮拍照识别或手动添加。
entries.en: No medication records yet. Use the button below to scan or add manually.

entries.zh: 感谢您完成生活习惯评估。这些精细的日常行为数据，将与您的病史、用药深度整合，帮助 AI 为您制定更具针对性的体检防御方案。
entries.en: Thank you for completing the lifestyle assessment. These details will integrate with your history and medications for a targeted exam plan.

entries.zh: 贴心提示：如果没有相关用药情况，请直接点击下方保存即可。
entries.en: Tip: If you have no relevant medications, tap Save below.

entries.zh: 出行沟通频繁，作息弹性大，饮食与休息不稳定
entries.en: Frequent travel and communication, flexible schedule, irregular diet and rest

entries.zh: 如果你之前在“饮食健康”中填写过相关数据，系统将为你自动带入。
entries.en: If you previously entered related data in Nutrition, it will be auto-filled here.

entries.zh: 了解您的过往手术史，有助于我们为您排查禁忌项目，并制定更安全的体检方案与长期随访计划。
entries.en: Knowing your surgical history helps us avoid contraindicated tests and plan safer exams and long-term follow-up.

entries.zh: 您过往是否曾接受过任何手术治疗（包含微创手术）？
entries.en: Have you ever had any surgery, including minimally invasive procedures?

entries.zh: 如果没有相关手术经历，请直接点击下方保存即可。
entries.en: If you have no relevant surgeries, tap Save below.

entries.zh: 贴心提示：保持健康是最好的状态，直接点击下方保存即可。
entries.en: Tip: Staying healthy is the best outcome—tap Save below.

entries.zh: 健康病史与症状记录汇总
了解你的既往病史、症状观察与随访情况，有助于我们更早识别潜在医疗风险，并定制更精准的复查周期与健康跟踪计划。
entries.en: Understanding your medical history, symptoms, and follow-up helps us identify risks earlier and tailor review cycles and health tracking.

entries.zh: 健康病史与症状记录说明
近期是否有任何身体不适？
拍照 / 上传病历凭证
系统将自动解析病历，提取症状与复查随访建议
entries.en: Medical records will be parsed automatically for symptoms and follow-up suggestions

entries.zh: 还没有填写饮食资料。可以从基础信息开始逐步完善。
entries.en: No nutrition profile yet. Start with basic information.

entries.zh: 设置成员身高，用于估算基础代谢和每日能量目标
entries.en: Set member height to estimate basal metabolism and daily energy target

entries.zh: 分步维护饮食目标、营养和体重管理
entries.en: Step through diet goals, nutrition, and weight management

entries.zh: 设置三大营养素比例与餐次分配
entries.en: Set macronutrient ratios and meal distribution

entries.zh: 选择目标模式、活跃水平和每周体重变化范围
entries.en: Select goal mode, activity level, and weekly weight change range

entries.zh: 根据基础信息计算建议摄入，支持手动调整到合理范围
entries.en: Suggested intake is calculated from basics; you can adjust to a reasonable range

entries.zh: 设置当前体重，用于计算摄入建议和体重目标
entries.en: Set current weight for intake suggestions and weight goals

entries.zh: 身高、体重、目标模式、营养目标
entries.en: Height, weight, goal mode, nutrition targets
